text:
Maya: Heads-up: new launch blog draft ready for a compact pass. Preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/launch-apr-v2. Need: benchmark callout phrasing, hero CTA microcopy, webinar snip, and HubSpot routing. Target publish Tue 10am PT.
Noah: Nice flow. Two tiny asks: 1) add one-line benchmark takeaway in the intro (‘p50 down Xms, p99 down Yms vs baseline’), 2) propose two hero CTA microcopy variants for A/B (short vs descriptive).
Maya: Will paste bench line once I pull numbers. Suggested CTAs I mocked: Variant A: "Join webinar" / "Request demo". Variant B: "See benchmarks" / "Talk to sales". Thoughts?
Priya: For HubSpot wiring I need the canonical mapping and hidden fields. Can we standardize utm and add hidden: product_segment=enterprise?
Maya: Mapping YAML (paste for wiring): ```utm_source=launch_blog&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=apr_launch_2026
hubspot_webinar_form=WEB-3321
hubspot_demo_form=DEMO-809
hidden_fields=product_segment:enterprise,trial_source:launch_blog
cta_primary=Join webinar -> WEB-3321
cta_secondary=Request demo -> DEMO-809
lead_tags=launch_apr,bench_interest
```
Clara: Copy pass: webinar blurb needs a softer lead-in. Try: "Join our engineers for a 30-min demo + Q&A to see the benchmark deep-dive." Also recommend short hero microcopy for mobile (<=18 chars).
Maya: Mobile hero CTA versions: "Join" / "Demo" (super short) and full: "Register: benchmark webinar" / "Request a demo".
Lena (Legal): Quick legal note: Replace any phrasing that implies endorsement of external model vendors. Also avoid unqualified superlatives. Use numbers where possible.
Maya: Got it 1 edited. No vendor mentions now; swapped to "industry-leading" where needed.
Noah: Bench numbers from spreadsheet: p50 reduced 24ms, p99 reduced 120ms vs our January baseline. Maya, can you add parenthetical: (p50 -24ms; p99 -120ms)?
Maya: Added that exact parenthetical to the intro and the benchmark section.
Priya: Routing plan confirmed: webinar signups -> nurture list "launch_apr_webinar"; demo requests -> SDR queue with tag "apr_launch_demo"; bench opt-ins -> product_eng_news. I'll create the HubSpot forms with the hidden fields once you lock the mapping.
ops-bot: Preview deploy finished: https://preview.redwood.ai/launch-apr-v2 (build #476).
Maya: SEO meta draft (<=155 chars): "Redwood Inference reduces LLM latency and cost for production workloads. Read benchmarks and register for a technical webinar."
Clara: Alternative short meta: "Lower latency, lower cost. See benchmarks + webinar." (shorter)
Lena (Legal): Legal quick-pass approved with edits. No flagged claims remain.
Maya: Small ask for Ops: can we schedule the blog publish for 2026-04-28 10:00 PT and enqueue announce posts to #marketing + #product with variant A CTAs? Also schedule an A/B for hero CTA (50/50).
ops-bot: Publish scheduled: 2026-04-28T17:00:00Z. Announcement queued to #marketing and #product. A/B CTA rollout configured: 50/50 split.
Priya: I'll follow up in this thread when HubSpot forms and sequences are live.
Maya: Thanks everyone. If anyone spots copy issues in the preview, drop a single-line note. Closing unless blockers.
